desc: Baba Ramdev emphasises the importance of yoga and demonstrates various asanas and breathing exercises that enable one to lead a healthy and stress-free life.

title: Satarupa
desc: Dr. Rupa unintentionally causes Shatadal's memory loss, leading him to see her as his only kin. Later, they fall for each other but when his past returns, he forgets her.

title: Choudhury Paribar
desc: A man expends all his efforts to keep his family together. However, his wife and older brother thwart his plans by creating rifts within the family.

desc: A man discovers a cave filled with stolen treasures and takes some for himself. However, things take a turn when the robbers start looking for their missing loot.
